pages.text: A $(item)void seed$() is a rift eye that was told to grow. On the gate, $(thing)Expand$() spends seeds and pushes the walls out. Whatever I built stays where it was.

pages.title: The Price
pages.text: One seed takes the room to two chunks a side. Three more, and a $(thing)nether star$(), take it to three.$(br2)Each step costs more than the last. Even nowhere, it seems, charges for land.
